```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1
        with:
          version: '7.4'

      - name: Install PowerShell modules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Force -Scope CurrentUser
          Install-Module -Name Pester -Force -Scope CurrentUser
          Install-Module -Name PSRule -Force -Scope CurrentUser

      - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $results = Invoke-PSAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Severity Warning
          if ($results.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Host "PSScriptAnalyzer found $($results.Count) issues."
            $results | Format-Table
            exit 1
          }

      - name: Run Pester tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Invoke-Pester -Path .\Tests -Output Detailed -EnableExit

      - name: Run PSRule
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Invoke-PSRule -Path . -Output Detailed
```
